content:
nina: starting int4 canary for bluejay-11b on lowlat pool. quick smoke then runs.
sam: saw a consistent EM drop on date-parse: 0.85 -> 0.79 after int4 artifacts.
jordan: seeing intermittent OOMs under modest concurrency (7). allocator logs show slab churn and repeated gc cycles.
eva: repro: max_new_tokens=1100 + microbatch=3 -> OOM after ~20 tokens. log: ERR allocate_kv_page(24MB) failed; slab_free=0; gc=92
nina: bluejay tokenization inflates some dates, so effective seq len higher -> bigger KV pressure.
sam: quality likely tied to per-layer clip used during mapping; LN-adjacent layers noisy.
jordan: runtime hypothesis: increased KV writes -> freelist thrash -> slow-path allocations -> timing perturbations -> token instability.
sam: mitigations: lower default max_new_tokens to 512 for int4, enable kv_warmup, narrow per-layer clip near LN and regen int4, cap microbatch concurrency to 5.
jordan: I can land a fast_free_slab flag (per-thread reserve) to smooth freelist contention for the canary.
ops-bot: enqueue canary deploy: deploy/bluejay-11b-int4 -> pool-lowlat-09 by nina @1992223600
deploy-bot: health OK after 4m; p50 +2ms, p95 +10ms; RSS -17% vs int8; slab_free_ratio improved after flag.
sam: re-run evals: date-parse EM = 0.83 after clip tweak + lower defaults. regressions reduced and within threshold.
nina: actions: sam regen int4 artifacts (ETA 3h), jordan land fast_free_slab flag (ETA 2h), ops set max_new_tokens->512 + kv_warmup for int4 (done), eva add token-stability CI (ETA tomorrow). will monitor 48h.
